checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Main subject is the supplied fox mascot
must.why: Fox is a faithful copy of the mascot.

must.item: Fox retains orange hoodie and friendly look
Full body visible incl. ears and feet
must.why: Ears to feet visible, feet close to the bottom edge but intact.

must.item: Pink/teal gradients and retro vaporwave treatment
must.why: Pink-to-teal sky, striped sun, neon grid. The palm tree is missing despite the message claiming it.

must.item: One square image with no added text
must.why: No text, but the image is not square: it is a portrait poster with a white border and a drop shadow.

faults.what: The output is a portrait poster with white margins and a shadow, not a clean square. The user asked for square.
The palm tree is missing, but the reply claims it is there.
The fox covers the sun and is simply pasted on, so the flat cartoon style does not blend with the neon scene.
The assistant says the image is square and includes a palm tree, which is inaccurate.

summary: The fox is faithfully kept and placed in a pink and teal vaporwave scene, but the result is a bordered portrait poster instead of a square, and the palm tree the reply mentions is missing.
